description: This file defines the interface and factory for the IWebAudioPlayerModuleService in the Rialto server IPC module. It declares classes for creating and managing web audio player service instances, including connection handling with IPC clients.

classes.name: IWebAudioPlayerModuleServiceFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of IWebAudioPlayerModuleService.

classes.name: IWebAudioPlayerModuleService
classes.description: Interface for the web audio player module service, including connection management with IPC clients.

methods.name: createFactory
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to a new IWebAudioPlayerModuleServiceFactory instance.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to a new IWebAudioPlayerModuleService, given a reference to IWebAudioPlayerService.

methods.name: clientConnected
methods.description: Handles the event when an IPC client connects.

methods.name: clientDisconnected
methods.description: Handles the event when an IPC client disconnects.
